extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in Tokyo 2020 Olympic controversies, sports fans, and observers of international sports politics
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic/news-style account documenting controversies, criticisms, and incidents surrounding the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games (doping allegations, media disputes, political tensions, environmental and safety concerns, etc.). Intended to inform readers about disputes and reactions rather than to provide prescriptive guidance.
